ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity region at the peduncle insertion point extending vertically towards the median notch. Wide low-intensity borders (10-30 pixels deep) trace the entire trailing edge. Scattered low-intensity linear streaks and mottled clusters are distributed across the high-intensity central regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the vertical axis of the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations range from 5 to 15 pixels. A significant jagged indentation/tissue loss is visible on the distal right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the lateral edges leading to acute, slightly recurved lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, roughly circular dark pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 pixel diameter) are visible near the outer margins and distal tips, particularly on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) traverse both lobes. Notable clusters include an intersecting 'X' pattern on the left lobe and parallel vertical streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the ventral surface; irregular traumatic indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique convergent intersection of two major linear abrasions on the mid-left lobe forming a high-contrast geometric cross.
